def frames_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    res=[]
    for col in sorted({x for row in g for x in row if x}):
        for r0,r1,c0,c1,comp in comps_of(g,col):
            # clean rectangle outline?
            ok=all(g[r][c]==col for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and \
               all(g[r][c]==col for c in (c0,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
            res.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,col,ok,len(comp)))
    return res
def solve(g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    fs=frames_of(g)
    # template = frame with stray interior same-color cells (max count)
    info={}
    for f in fs:
        r0,r1,c0,c1,col,ok,_=f
        inner=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        stray=sum(1 for r,c in inner if g[r][c]==col)
        info[(r0,r1,c0,c1,col)]=(stray,(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1),ok)
    tmpl=max(info,key=lambda k:info[k][0])
    tr0,tr1,tc0,tc1,tcol=tmpl

def frames_of(g):
    res=[]
    for col in sorted({x for row in g for x in row if x}):
        for r0,r1,c0,c1,comp in comps_of(g,col):
            ok=all(g[r][c]==col for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and \
               all(g[r][c]==col for c in (c0,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
            inner=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
            stray=sum(1 for r,c in inner if g[r][c]==col)
            res.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,col,stray,(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1),ok))
    return res
def solve(g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    fs=frames_of(g)
    # template: frame whose interior contains its own color cells
    tmpl=max((f for f in fs if f[5]>0), key=lambda f:f[5])
    tr0,tr1,tc0,tc1,tcol,_,_,_=tmpl
    pat=[(r-tr0-1,c-tc0-1) for r in range(tr0+1,tr1) for c in range(tc0+1,tc1) if g[r][c]==tcol]
    ph,pw=max(p[0] for p in pat)+1,max(p[1] for p in pat)+1
    for f in fs:
        if f is tmpl: continue
        r0,r1,c0,c1,col,*_ = f
        ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        if (ih,iw)!=(ph,pw): continue
        for pr,pc in pat:
            rr,cc=r0+1+pr,c0+1+pc
            out[rr][cc]=col
        # erase entire erased frame to background
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if g[r][c]==col: out[r][c]=0
    return out

# So: template's noise = its empty interior spots; fill them with template color in output.
# Then every other frame gets template's noise pattern stamped into its interior, recolored to that frame's color; frames with different interior sizes get erased entirely (frame+interior->0).
def solve(g):
    items=[]
    for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames_clean(g):
        inner=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
        same=[p for p in inner if g[p[0]][p[1]]==col]
        noise=[(r-r0-1,c-c0-1) for r,c in inner if g[r][c]==0]
        if not noise: continue
        items.append((col,(r0,r1,c0,c1),noise))
    if not items: return [row[:] for row in g]
    tmpl=max(items,key=lambda x:len(x[2]))
    tr,_,tc,_=tmpl[1]; nset=set(tmpl[2])
    ph=max(p[0] for p in nset)+1; pw=max(p[1] for p in nset)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # fill template interior noise with its own color
    for r,c in [(tr+a+1,tc+b+1) for a,b in tmpl[2]]: out[r][c]=tmpl[0]
    for col2,box,nz in items:
        if box==tmpl[1]: continue
        ih,iw=box[1]-box[0]-1,box[3]-box[2]-1
        if (ih,iw)!=(ph,pw):
            for r in range(box[0],box[1]+1):
                for c in range(box[2],box[3]+1): out[r][c]=0
            continue
        for a,b in nz: out[box[0]+a+1][box[2]+b+1]=col2
    return out

            if a!=b: n+=1
            if n<=6: print(a,'   ',b)
        print('ndiff',n)

def solve(g):
    items=[]
    for col,box in frames_clean(g):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        inn=[(a,b) for a in range(r1-r0-1+1) for b in range(c1-c0-1)] if False else None
        ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        inn=[(a,b) for a in range(ih) for b in range(iw)]
        noise={(a,b) for a,b in inn if g[r0+a+1][c0+b+1]==col}
        items.append(dict(color=col,box=box,pat=noise,sz=(ih,iw)))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    t0=[t for t in items if t['pat']][0]
    for t in items:
        if t is t0: continue
        r0,r1,c0,c1=t['box']
        ih,iw=t['sz']
        if (ih,iw)!=t0['sz']: continue
        # clear any pre-existing same-color spots
        for a,b in inn_range(t0['box'],t0['pat']):
            rr,cc=t0['box'][0]+a+1,t0['box'][2]+b+1
        # simpler: just stamp over anything

            # placeholder
        for a,b in t0['pat']:

            out[rr][cc]=t['color']
    return out

def solve(g):
    itms=[]
    for col,b in frames_clean(g):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=b; ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        pat=[[g[r][c]==col for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
        itms.append(dict(col=col,pos=b,ih=ih,iw=iw,pat=pat))
    full=[t for t in itms if any(v for row in t['pat'] for v in row)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]

    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(tuple(map(tuple,t['pat'])) for t in full)

    return out

# Scan ALL demo input frames: find whose noise mask matches each target's stamped pattern (ignoring color).
def frames(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);res=[];seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c];stack=[(r,c)];cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop()
                if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or (x,y) in seen or g[x][y]!=col: continue
                seen.add((x,y));cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
            rs=[a for a,b in cells];cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

def find_frames(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);res=[];seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c];stack=[(r,c)];cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop()
                if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or (x,y) in seen or g[x][y]!=col: continue
                seen.add((x,y));cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
            rs=[a for a,b in cells];cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            ok=all(g[a][b]==col for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a==r0 or a==r1 or b==c0 or b==c1)
            if not ok or r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            inn=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0+1,c1)] for a in range(r0+1,r1)]
            noisy=sum(1 for row in inn for v in row if v!=0 and v!=col)
            res.append(dict(col=col,pos=(r0,r1,c0,c1),inn=inn,noisy=noisy))
    return res
for k_ in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3'):
    fr=find_frames(G[k_+' input'])
    print(k_,[(f['noisy'],f['col'],f['pos'][0]) for f in fr])

def find_frames(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);res=[];seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c];stack=[(r,c)];cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop()
                if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or (x,y) in seen or g[x][y]!=col: continue
                seen.add((x,y));cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
            rs=[a for a,b in cells];cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            ok=all(g[a][b]==col for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a==r0 or a==r1 or b==c0 or b==c1)
            if not ok or r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            inn=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0+1,c1)] for a in range(r0+1,r1)]
            n=sum(1 for row in inn for v in row if v!=0 and v!=col)
            res.append(dict(col=col,pos=(r0,r1,c0,c1),inn=inn,noisy=n))

def frames(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);seen=set();res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c];stack=[(r,c)];cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop()
                if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or (x,y) in seen or g[x][y]!=col: continue
                seen.add((x,y));cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): stack.append((x+dx,y+dy))
            rs=[a for a,b in cells];cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            inn=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0+1,c1)] for a in range(r0+1,r1)]
            res.append(dict(col=col,pos=(r0,c0,r1,c1),inn=inn,dims=(len(inn),len(inn[0]))))
    return res

def find_boxes(g):

            if g[r0][c0]==0 or (r0,c0) in seen: continue
            col=g[r0][c0];cells=[];q=[(r0,c0)]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop()
                if not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or (x,y) in seen or g[x][y]!=col: continue
                seen.add((x,y));cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): q.append((x+dx,y+dy))
            rr=[a for a,b in cells];cc=[b for a,b in cells]
            r1,c1=max(rr),max(cc)
            if len(cells)<3 or r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue
            inn=[[g[a][b] for b in range(c0+1,c1)] for a in range(r0+1,r1)]
